'''NTL''' is a [[C++]] library for doing [[number theory]]. NTL supports arbitrary length [[integer]] and [[Arbitrary precision arithmetic|arbitrary precision]] [[floating point]] [[arithmetic]], [[finite fields]], [[Vector space|vectors]], [[Matrix (mathematics)|matrices]], [[polynomials]], [[lattice basis reduction]] and basic [[linear algebra]]. NTL is [[free software]] released under the [[GNU Lesser General Public License]] v2.1.<ref>{{Cite web|title=NTL: A Library for doing Number Theory|url=https://shoup.net/ntl/|access-date=2020-06-06|website=shoup.net}}</ref>
